[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Step 4: Prioritize Tasks based on importance and urgency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Step 5: Break Down Large Tasks into smaller, manageable chunks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Step 6: Schedule Tasks realistically, allowing for breaks and self-care.
